evidence.title: Reported observation (same-results)
evidence.text: "Consequently, although the AMD for silicone rubber is 227 nm, almost half the particle mass is larger than 1000 nm." (source: same-results, PDF page 2) (SAME: spacecraft-material smoke; mechanistic evidence only, not solid-material behaviour) Curator source-scope annotations: This quotation is from the original SAME results on PDF page 2; SAME-R starts on PDF page 4. AMD means arithmetic mean diameter, not median diameter. Almost half refers to particle mass, not particle count. No run-level detector-performance dataset has been imported here; this does not mean the source or wider literature lacks detector results.

evidence.title: PSI-102 — imported PSI source table
evidence.text: IMPORTED SOURCE TABLE, NOT A VALIDATED PERFORMANCE DATASET. Smoke and Aerosol Measurement Experiment; PSI-102_Experimental table_SAME.csv; DOI 10.60555/gd4k-8h62; 8 source rows. Row count is not a count of independent tests or detector-performance labels. Original column headers: Sample #; Sample Material; Air Flow (cm/s); Weight loss rate (mg/min); Aging Duration (minutes). Original cells, including unknowns and censored values, remain in the downloadable table. No missing physical values or outcome labels have been inferred. Source: https://psi.nasa.gov/physci/repo/data/investigations/PSI-102.

evidence.title: SAME / SAME-R — investigation overview (not test results)
evidence.text: OVERVIEW / OBJECTIVES ONLY. Characterize spacecraft-material smoke and assess smoke-detector response in reduced gravity. Materials: Smoke generated from spacecraft materials; the overview lists Teflon, Kapton, cellulose and silicone rubber. Hardware: Smoke-generation, aerosol measurement and detector-test apparatus; configurations need the original investigation documentation. Measurements: Aerosol number, size and mass-related measurements, plus ionization and photoelectric detector evaluation. NASA reports material-dependent smoke-size distributions; these aggregate results are not individual detector-performance records. Limits: No numerical SAME detector-performance time series are curated here. The NASA document includes aggregate smoke-property results; source-table smoke-generation conditions do not establish alarm sensitivity, false-alarm rate or timing for a chosen habitat. Source: NASA SAME / SAME-R document, PDF pages 1–2 and reflight section.

outside: Investigation overviews describe objectives and scope only. They are not measured test results or detector-performance data.

Summarize only SAME / SAME-R. Retrieved items are a bounded subset, not the entire investigation. The original NASA document includes results as well as objectives. Aggregate publication findings are kept separate from individual test rows and detector validation. SAME-R has its own profile. Its modified hardware and materials are not assumed equivalent to the original SAME configuration. PSI source-table metadata remains separate from curated solid-fuel outcome rows. Smoke generation settings do not become detector response or alarm-performance measurements.
response.summary: OBSERVED: The arithmetic mean diameter (AMD) for silicone rubber is 227 nm, with half the particle mass being larger than 1000 nm. DATA_GAP: No numerical detector-performance time series are curated for the SAME investigation.
